_doc: Quick profile: 12 short tasks for fast recipe comparison (60-90s per run). Designed so that 3 runs give a pass-rate with ~+/-5% margin at the worst case (p=0.5, n=36) and ~+/-8% at p=0.9. Use --runs 3 for the minimum confident comparison; --runs 1 for a sanity check; --runs 5 for the strongest signal. Every task is solver in well under 600 tokens by the model in question, so completion-budget mismatch cannot bias the comparison.

tasks.prompt: Write a Python 3 script in a fenced ```python block that prints the reverse of the string 'hello world'. Do not include any other text.
Write a Python 3 script in a fenced ```python block that prints 'yes' if the string 'racecar' is a palindrome, else 'no'. Do not include any other text.
tasks.good_output:
```python
s = 'racecar'
print('yes' if s == s[::-1] else 'no')
```
tasks.bad_output:
```python

print('no' if s == s[::-1] else 'yes')
```

tasks.prompt: Write a Python 3 script in a fenced ```python block that prints the sum of squares of integers from 1 to 10 inclusive, as a single integer. Do not include any other text.
